sources.source: NREL Wind Integration National Dataset Toolkit (WTK) hourly wind resource data for the NREL site nearest each 10 km CONUS grid point; simulated with NREL reV + SAM (NREL Reference 5.5 MW onshore / 12 MW offshore turbines) into hourly capacity-factor profiles for weather years 2007-2013.

Maps each Princeton capacity area (CPA_ID) to the NREL resource site used for its profile and the great-circle distance (profile_dist) between them, from a 10 km CONUS grid with nearest-site selection.

Maps each Princeton capacity area (CPA_ID) to the NREL resource site used for its profile and the great-circle distance (profile_dist) between them, from a 10 km CONUS grid with nearest-site selection.

NREL National Solar Radiation Database (NSRDB) hourly solar resource data for the NREL site nearest each 10 km CONUS grid point; simulated with NREL reV + SAM PVWatts v8 (1-axis bifacial) into hourly AC capacity-factor profiles for weather years 2007-2013.

Maps each Princeton capacity area (CPA_ID) to the NREL resource site used for its profile and the great-circle distance (profile_dist) between them, from a 10 km CONUS grid with nearest-site selection.
